coverage.evidence: ScheduleTemplateHelpers.cs:18-26 joins the groups; ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:21-72 defines schedule.next.at, date, in, relative, full, title, game, duration and isRecurring with no argument, and viewerTime with exactly 1 argument; ScheduleListHelpers.cs:19-31 makes schedule.list take exactly 1 argument, a whole number from 1 to 10 (MaxListed=10 at line 64, StreamText.cs:157-158); week and today take none (ScheduleListHelpers.cs:32-61); vacation and vacation.until (ScheduleVacationHelpers.cs:17-33); link and ical (ScheduleLinkHelpers.cs:17-27); an argument count outside the range returns null (BroadcastRow.cs:47-50).

DayAndTime, DayAndDate, ShortDayAndTime and ShortDate use culture day and month names and the HH:mm clock (BroadcastText.cs:53-88, StreamText.cs:112-115); next.in is Words precision 1 and relative adds 'in', or 'over' in Dutch (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:75-83, BroadcastText.cs:45-50); full adds 'next stream', or 'volgende stream' in Dutch (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:37-43); duration is Brief of end-start: 3h, 2h 30m, 45m (BroadcastText.cs:29-42); isRecurring gives the true/false flag (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:55-59); list items are joined with ' · ' (ScheduleListHelpers.cs:65-70); links are built from ChannelName and TwitchChannelId (ScheduleLinkHelpers.cs:20, 26).

Schedule rows carry TemplateHelperContexts.Standard, which leaves out Viewer (BroadcastRow.cs:53, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:17-22); the Viewer surface holds only helpers whose row lists Viewer (TemplateHelperContext.cs:57-61), so they are not available in viewer text even with the 'Viewer Templates' feature on (FeatureService.cs:92-93); the contexts are Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook (TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-61, TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40).

ViewAsync keeps segments with CanceledUntil null and EndTime > now, ordered by StartTime, so a running segment still counts; the vacation is kept separately while EndTime > now (ScheduleData.cs:64-77); next.* reads Upcoming[0] (ScheduleRows.cs:42-53) with no vacation filter; vacation helpers give string.Empty when there is no vacation (ScheduleVacationHelpers.cs:21-32); one fetch per render (ScheduleData.cs:24-58); app token, so no extra scope is needed (TwitchScheduleApi.cs:53-58).

The channel zone is call.Timezone from User.Timezone, set by the Bot basics Timezone field (BroadcastCall.cs:28, TemplateRenderScope.cs:34, ChannelRegistry.cs:704, 721, ChannelService.cs:597-598, settings/i18n/en.json:97-99); an unset or unknown zone falls back to UTC (StreamText.cs:106-110); language comes from Channel.Language and defaults to English when empty (ChannelRegistry.cs:705, 722, NumberCulture.cs:22-25); viewerTime uses the named zone only if TryFindSystemTimeZoneById succeeds, else null (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:60-72, 85-86); no next segment gives null, so the token prints as typed, and a null category does the same (ScheduleRows.cs:42-53, ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:45-49); an empty list gives an empty string (ScheduleListHelpers.cs:47, 56-59); a 404 counts as an empty schedule (TwitchScheduleApi.cs:66-71); a failed read gives null, so every Over row prints as typed while the OfChannel links do not depend on the read (ScheduleRows.cs:23-39, 55-67, BroadcastFetch.cs:31-43).

reader_answers.evidence: next.at, date and full use call.Timezone (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:24, 29, 42); viewerTime takes 1 zone argument checked by TryFindSystemTimeZoneById (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:60-72, 85-86); the Timezone field is in Bot basics (settings/i18n/en.json:97-99, ChannelService.cs:597-598).

Timezone is nullable and unset by default, with UTC as the fallback (User.cs:55, StreamText.cs:106-110); the schedule read uses TwitchHelixAuth.App, so no streamer scope is needed (TwitchScheduleApi.cs:53-58).

Print-as-typed causes: unknown or missing zone (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:64-71, BroadcastRow.cs:47-50), list count outside 1 to 10 (StreamText.cs:157-158), no next segment (ScheduleRows.cs:51), Twitch down (ScheduleRows.cs:38); empty results for empty lists and vacation (ScheduleListHelpers.cs:47, 56-59, ScheduleVacationHelpers.cs:24, 32); in and relative are computed from StartTime - Now (ScheduleNextHelpers.cs:75-78).

Upcoming filters only canceled and ended segments, not vacation days (ScheduleData.cs:69-74), so next.at can fall inside the break; vacation.until is DayAndDate of the vacation EndTime while it is not over (ScheduleVacationHelpers.cs:26-32, ScheduleData.cs:75).
